summary.short: Federal tax decree granting incentives to taxpayers that start operations and carry out productive activities inside Polos de Desarrollo Económico para el Bienestar: immediate 100% deduction for new fixed assets and additional 25% deduction for training or innovation spending, fiscal years 2025–2030. Effective on DOF publication.
summary.long: Federal tax decree granting incentives for taxpayers that start operations and carry out productive activities inside Polos de Desarrollo Económico para el Bienestar, for fiscal years 2025 to 2030. Taxpayers resident in Mexico (and non-residents with a permanent establishment) and developers authorised by a state entity may apply an immediate 100% deduction for new fixed assets used in a pole (Art. Tercero), and an additional 25% deduction for increases in training or innovation spending (Art. Cuarto). Eligibility requires tax compliance and a fiscal domicile in the pole; the training incentive also requires a dual-education programme with the Secretaría de Educación Pública, and taxpayers subject to certain tax-authority presumptions are excluded (Art. Segundo, Séptimo). The Secretaría de Economía declares each pole on the collegiate opinion of an inter-ministerial committee, which the decree creates with guideline-making powers (Art. Primero, Décimo). The SAT issues general rules (Art. Décimo Tercero). The decree sets no penalties; non-compliance means losing the incentives and paying tax, indexation and surcharges. The text has no AI-specific provisions; employment_labor is assigned because the vocabulary has no tax-incentive domain.

enforcement.max_penalty_text: No penalty amount stated. The decree states that application of the stimulus is excluded (no procede) in the listed situations.
enforcement.penalty_reference: Código Fiscal de la Federación arts. 69, 69-B, 69-B Bis, 17-H and 17-H Bis, cross-referenced as conditions

evidence.quote: No procederá la aplicación de los estímulos fiscales establecidos en este decreto cuando los contribuyentes o desarrolladores se encuentren en cualquiera de los siguientes supuestos
